name: long-glide
about: Portamento now runs off, then 1–127: the agent sets the longest glide and reads it back.

steps.say: my bass on track 3 should slide between every note with the longest glide the op-xy can do. set that up and tell me the number it shows
now no glide at all on it

name: sampler-locks
about: Region locks: the multisampler takes none, the synth sampler locks a point on one step.

steps.say: on track 8, can I make step 3 play from a different loop start than the other steps?
ok then put track 8 on the synth sampler, give it notes on steps 1 to 4, and lock the loop start of step 3 to 50%

name: linked-transpose
about: Linked tracks now sound, transpose is heard: the agent explains and sets both.

steps.say: link track 4 to track 3 so that when I play track 3 I hear both. how do I do that?
transpose the whole project up 2 semitones. do my drums move too?
